sloka: यदा तु ते वरं दद्यात्स्वयमुत्थाप्य राघवः ।व्यवस्थाप्य महाराजं तमिमं वृणुया वरम् ॥२-९-२९॥
transliteration: yadā tu te varaṁ dadyātsvayamutthāpya rāghavaḥ ।vyavasthāpya mahārājaṁ tamimaṁ vṛṇuyā varam ॥2-9-29॥

translations.english: When Dasaratha personally lifts you from the floor and asks you what you want you may make him settle down and ask him for these boons:
